task: Regression of SOH at observation time for batteries not seen in train (not forecasting or RUL)
target_unit: percent, MAE/RMSE errors in percentage points

excluded_features.battery_id: Group ID used for splitting, not a feature.
excluded_features.observation_id: Observation ID used for tracking, not a feature.
excluded_features.remaining_useful_life_cycles: Alternative target or health label, not an input for SOH regression.
excluded_features.failure_risk_label: Alternative target or health label, not an input for SOH regression.
excluded_features.degradation_category: Alternative target or health label, not an input for SOH regression.
excluded_features.manufacture_date: Raw date excluded from the baseline, battery_age_days is used instead.
excluded_features.observation_date: Raw date excluded from the baseline, battery_age_days is used instead.
excluded_features.last_service_date: Raw date excluded from the baseline, battery_age_days is used instead.
excluded_features.internal_resistance_mohm: Candidate synthetic sensor proxy, only for a separate ablation after reviewing origin and availability.
excluded_features.voltage_avg_v: Candidate synthetic sensor proxy, only for a separate ablation after reviewing origin and availability.
excluded_features.current_avg_a: Candidate synthetic sensor proxy, only for a separate ablation after reviewing origin and availability.
excluded_features.charge_time_avg_min: Candidate synthetic sensor proxy, only for a separate ablation after reviewing origin and availability.

availability_assumption: Usage, environment summaries and metadata are known at observation time. The source does not document aggregation windows, no claim of prediction before a session or into the future.
timesteps: Not used: dates are missing and cumulative counters are not always monotonic, requires further temporal audit.
preprocessing_status: Not fitted here. Imputation, encoding, scaling and data-driven selection may learn from train only.
balancing: No class balancing because the target is continuous.
